name: io.github.Coinversaa/mcp-server
description: Read-only crypto intelligence for AI agents: 103 tools for Hyperliquid trader analytics, builder-revenue analytics, position lifecycles with MAE/MFE, trader archetypes, HIP-4 outcome contracts, cohorts, live market data, builder-dex markets, and cross-market asset taxonomy. Hosted endpoint uses OAuth 2.1 (PKCE + dynamic client registration); stdio package uses a Coinversa API key. No trading or fund movement. Support: chat@coinversaa.ai

environmentVariables.description: Coinversa API key (starts with cvsa_). Required by the stdio server for every tool. Get one at https://developers.coinversa.ai/keys.
environmentVariables.name: COINVERSAA_API_KEY
